description:
APPLICATION
FOR THE ERECTION OF THE ROOF ALTERATIONS AND EXTENSIONS FOR THE ADDITIONS OF 2
X SELF-CONTAINED FLATS AT ROOF LEVEL.
decision_conditions:
The proposed
  development fails to take a design led approach that responds to the sites
  context and would result in an unduly prominent form of development that
  would be out of character with the prevailing form of development, would have
  an overbearing impact on neighbouring amenity, and would have a poor outlook,
  poor external amenity areas and has the potential to provide a substandard
  internal layout to the detriment of future occupiers which contrary to Merton
  Local Plan Policies D12.1, D12.3 and D12.4 and Policies D1, D4 and D6 of the
  London Plan.

<p><span style="font-size: 11pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">In the absence of adequate refuse and recycling
storage facilities for the development, the applicant has not demonstrated that
the scheme would not adversely impact on the free flow of traffic in the
locality to the detriment of highway and pedestrian safety and result in
material harm to the visual amenity of the area. The scheme is contrary to
Policies D4, SI 7 &amp; SI 8 of the London Plan 2021, Merton Local Plan 2024
policy D12.2, D12.3 and W14.4.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 11pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">By reasons of absence of a completed Merton's
Energy Assessment Template for Minor Residential Schemes detailing how the
development will meet Merton's minimum requirements the proposal fails to
comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies CC2.1, CC2.2 and CC2.4.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 11pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">By reason of absence of a completed Good Homes
Alliance Overheating Risk Tool, Dynamic overheating modelling outputs demonstrating
how the risk of overheating has been mitigated the proposal fails to comply
with Merton Local Plan 2024 policies CC2.1, D12.2 and D12.3.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:
Aptos;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The irregular shape of the proposed dwelling coupled with the lack
of detail on a usable layout fails to demonstrate that an acceptable standard
of residential accommodation and living space could be delivered. In addition
the limited outlook available would result in a poor standard of accommodation.
The proposals would therefore be contrary to policy D6 of the London Plan and
Merton Local Plan policies D12.1, D12.3 and D12.4</span></p>
